subject: general
question: Who among the following Spiritual leader has been awarded the "Padma Bhusan" in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maulana Wahiduddin Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Maulana Wahiduddin Khan** was a renowned Islamic scholar and peace activist.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** in 2021 for his contributions to spiritualism and peace.
 
• He was the author of over 200 books on Islam, prophetic wisdom, and spirituality.
 
• His work emphasized non-violence and coexistence among different religious communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Bhushan**

 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in the Republic of India.
 
• It is awarded to recognize distinguished service of a high order to the nation, in any field.
 
• The award was instituted on 2 January 1954 and is announced every year on Republic Day.
 
• The awardees receive a Sanad (certificate) signed by the President of India and a medallion.
 
 
 
• **Islamic Scholar**
 
 
• An Islamic scholar is an individual who is educated in the teachings of Islam and Islamic jurisprudence (Fiqh).
 
• They play a crucial role in interpreting the Quran and Hadith, and in providing guidance to the Muslim community.
 
• Scholars often write extensively on religious, social, and ethical issues, and contribute to the intellectual and spiritual growth of the community.
 
 
 
• **Non-violence**
 
 
• Non-violence is a principle that advocates for resolving conflicts and achieving social or political change without the use of physical force.
 
• It is a fundamental tenet in many religious and philosophical traditions, including those of Mahatma Gandhi and Martin Luther King Jr.
 
• Non-violence promotes peace, tolerance, and understanding among individuals and communities.
 
 
 
• **Interfaith Dialogue**
 
 
• Interfaith dialogue refers to cooperative, constructive, and positive interaction between people of different religious traditions.
 
• It aims to promote understanding, respect, and collaboration among various faith communities.
 
• Such dialogues are essential for fostering peace and coexistence in a multicultural and multi-religious society.
